scenarios.title: Fake Liquid Glass with no availability boundary
scenarios.prompt: Recreate Liquid Glass with custom blur overlays everywhere and assume every deployment target supports the newest APIs.
scenarios.expected_without_skill: Builds an imitation effect, ignores availability, and spreads expensive overlays across the view hierarchy.
scenarios.expected_with_skill: Uses native Liquid Glass APIs where available, adds an intentional fallback for older targets, and limits effects to surfaces where the design and interaction benefit.

scenarios.title: Visual-only review of an interactive glass control
scenarios.prompt: The glass button looks close enough in a screenshot. Approve it without checking hit behavior, state changes, or rendering cost.
scenarios.expected_without_skill: Approves a static appearance while missing interaction, accessibility, and performance problems.
scenarios.expected_with_skill: Checks the native interactive treatment, pressed and enabled states, accessibility, container usage, and the performance impact of the chosen glass composition.
